I have used this product since childhood.  My mother used is forever.  I am now 72 yrs old and still loving it.

Most 20 something's I know do not do that, and think I am an old soul. Well I am an old soul with delightfully baby- soft skin!  This powder is the best. reviews.x: I've used this since I received my first container at Ft McClellan, AL as Christmas gift during AIT in 1970 until spring 2015.  Loved it. Unfortunately, it's been removed from market.  Woman won $13 million lawsuit in 2015 against company that made it.  Jury decided she had contracted mesothelioma from using Cashmere Bouquet talcum powder for about 15 years. I love it and I think it is exactly the same.  I've continued to use it on my beds and love the way the fragrance makes me feel when I lie down. For me it's akin to luxury. My Mom has been using this product for years.  It's the only one that she's not allergic to.  When we moved to Maryland we were unable to find it in any store.  Driving back to NJ for this was out of the question.  When we were up visiting I could stock up but now we can't find it there either.  I ordered this one evening and in less than 2 days I received it.  Thanks for your help.

I gave this a 5 star rating because this is the best talc ever.  When I purchased this I was not sure how long I would have to wait for it to be delivered.  Well, it was packaged perfectly.  Each container was wrapped individually in plastic so no talc could spill out.  I was completely satisfied with the product, the packaging and the delivery.  I had mentioned it to family and friends and hopefully they will order some also.  Will I order again?  You bet I will.  Thanks  Dee Scandurra

I have been using Cashmere Bouquet body powder classic floral for many years. It keeps me dry with a pleasant, but not overwhelming scent. In recent years, I have only been able to find it online, but I haven't been able to find a different powder that I like as much.

Any time I try to use this I need to have the vacuum cleaner handy because the top pops off.  If I try to hold it on the powder still flies all over.  Now it's happily contained (almost full) in a trash bag at the local landfill.

I have used this powder after a shower for many years but I am having trouble finding it locally. It used to be available in drugstores and grocery stores but for some reason these stores no longer carry it. I think it is a little pricey but I will continue to buy it if I am able to find it. I like the texture and the light fragrance of the powder.

This product is no longer available in my area.  My 92 year old mother-in-law, who is is the rest home, requested it.  I was very pleased to find it on Amazon and she is happy to have the fine talc that she remembers from her younger days.  I bought some for myself and as gifts for friends. I am very pleased with it.

Cashmere Bouquet body powder harkens back to a time when it was a staple in every lady's bath routine! Today it still has the same lovely fragrance one remembers, the same luxurious feel and it is still the same "simple pleasure" it has been for generations!

My Grandma from McEwen, Tennessee always sprinkled this on us after we took a bath in her kitchen in a galvanized steel washtub.  She heated the water on the wood stove.  Grandma died in 1977, and this reminds me of her. It smells like roses, and I love it.

This is the powder my mom remembers using when she was young.  I found it at Amazon and ordered it.  It came so quickly.  Mom was so surprised Christmas morning when she opened it and the fragrance brings back fond memories.  Thanks Amazon.

A nice blast from the past! When I was growing up in the 60's, there was always a container of Cashmere Bouquet Powder in the bathroom. It still smells the same, and I was happy to find it here on Amazon. Perfect as an after bath powder.

Just like yesterday, this powder flooded my memory bank from years past.  Great and familiar fragrance, silky on skin and not overpowering.
It arrive fine and in good condition; but I was disappointed that it did not have the same fragrance that I remember.

claims.text: Many reviewers have used this powder for decades, often having been introduced to it by their mothers, and love its nostalgic scent.
Reviewers frequently mention being unable to find the product in local stores and are glad it is available online again.
Some reviewers complain about the price, with one returning the item because a single bottle cost $98.
A few reviewers raise serious health concerns, citing cancer and mesothelioma settlements linked to the product.
Some reviewers report problems with the container, saying the top pops off and makes a mess.
